title: ACDF Result Receipt (off-chain carrier of a registry record)
description: A portable description of what ACDFRegistry.getResult(issueId) and getIssue(issueId) return, for indexers and off-chain consumers. The receipt is a CARRIER of the registry record, never a substitute for it: the registry instance named in `registry` is the normative source, and a receipt proves nothing about another chain. Three dimensions are reported separately: procedure state, outcome type, and (per consumer and effect) enactment status.

registry.description: ACDFRegistry instance that holds the record.

policyRegistry.description: Co-deployed ACDFPolicyRegistry the issue's policy lives in.

policyId.description: Policy version the issue is bound to (frozen at filing).

outcomeType.description: Outcome type. Meaningful once state is Final; 'None' before.

outcomeYes.description: For Decided results: true = the issue's yes effect applies.

decidedAt.description: Instant the adopted result became determined (not the settlement call).

sourceRound.description: 1-based round whose decision was adopted. May differ from roundCount when an appeal round ended in NoDecision and the earlier decision was kept.

disposition.description: Opaque reference to the consumer's committed NoDecision disposition.

enactments.description: Informative enactment log entries as recorded by the bound consumer. Authoritative execution state lives at the consumer.

chainFinality.description: Optional. Procedural finality (state = Final) is not chain finality; a carrier may state the block and confirmation depth it observed the record at.
